test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per a list compiled by the United Nations Population Division, _____ is the world's fastest-growing city with a 44% increase in population between 2015 and 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Malappuram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Malappuram, which recorded a 44 percent rise in its population from 2015 to 2020, topped the ranking as the world's fastest-growing city as per a list compiled by the United Nations Population Division.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://images.indianexpress.com/2020/01/malappuram.jpg] **

 
• These** cities are seeing rapid urbanization,** and the main reason is the inclusion of new areas within the UA’s limits.
 
• **In Kerala, urbanization is driven by a move away from agriculture, which leads to a change in a village’s Census classification status.**
 
• While the** pace of urbanization has been slower in the North**, some **unnaturally high increases in the population can be expected after the 2021 Census **because in some cases, villages on the peripheries were brought within the administrative boundaries of the cities.
